cases.sentence: Господи, вспомни ___ и все огорчения, которые он перенес.
cases.translation: Lord, remember David and all the hardships he endured.
cases.explain: Давида is the direct object of the transitive verb вспомни (remember), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он поклялся ___ и дал обет сильному Иакова.
cases.translation: He swore to the Lord and made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob.
cases.explain: The verb поклялся (swore) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Не войду в свой ___ и не лягу в свою постель.
cases.translation: I will not enter my house or lie on my bed.
cases.explain: Дом is the direct object of the preposition в (into), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не дам сна своим ___ и векам своим дремы.
cases.translation: I will give no sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids.
cases.explain: The verb дам (give) with the dative object (not to give to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Пока не найду место ___, жилище сильному Иакова.
cases.translation: Until I find a place for the Lord, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.
cases.explain: The word место (place) takes the dative case when indicating purpose or function.

cases.sentence: Вот мы слышали о нем в Ефрафе, нашли его на полях ___.
cases.translation: We have heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) before a proper noun in location uses the genitive case when referring to possession or belonging.

cases.sentence: Встань, Господи, и приди на место своего ___, ты и ковчег твоей силы.
cases.translation: Arise, Lord, and come to your place of rest, you and the ark of your strength.
cases.explain: The word место (place) in the genitive construction 'место покоя' (place of rest) uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Обильно благословлю его ___, нищих его насыщу хлебом.
cases.translation: I will abundantly bless his provisions; I will satisfy his poor with bread.
cases.explain: The verb благословлю (bless) with the meaning of 'supply abundantly' governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Господи, вспомни Давида и все огорчения, которые он перенес.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask God to remember about David?
reading.explain: The text asks God to 'вспомни Давида и все огорчения, которые он перенес' (remember David and all the hardships he endured).

reading.ru: Он поклялся Господу и дал обет сильному Иакова, «Не войду в свой дом и не лягу в свою постель».
reading.question: What vow did David make to God?
options: He would not enter his house or lie on his bed until finding a place for God
He would never leave the temple
He would build a great altar
reading.correct: He would not enter his house or lie on his bed until finding a place for God
reading.explain: The vow explicitly states David 'Не войду в свой дом и не лягу в свою постель' (will not enter his house or lie on his bed) until he finds a dwelling place for the Lord.

reading.ru: Вот мы слышали о нем в Ефрафе, нашли его на полях Иаара, пойдем к его жилищу и поклонимся у подножия его.
reading.question: What does the people decide to do after finding the resting place?
options: Go to it and worship at its footstool
reading.correct: Go to it and worship at its footstool
reading.explain: The text declares 'пойдем к его жилищу и поклонимся у подножия его' (let us go to his dwelling and worship at his footstool).

reading.ru: Встань, Господи, и приди на место своего покоя, ты и ковчег твоей силы.
reading.question: What is God called to do?
options: Arise and come to His resting place with the ark of His strength
reading.correct: Arise and come to His resting place with the ark of His strength
reading.explain: The invitation is 'Встань, Господи, и приди на место своего покоя, ты и ковчег твоей силы' (Arise, Lord, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your strength).

reading.ru: Ведь Господь избрал Сион и пожелал сделать его своим жилищем.
reading.question: Why will the Lord come to His resting place?
options: Because He has chosen Zion as His dwelling place
reading.correct: Because He has chosen Zion as His dwelling place
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь избрал Сион и пожелал сделать его своим жилищем' (the Lord has chosen Zion and desired to make it His dwelling).

reading.ru: Обильно благословлю его пищей, нищих его насыщу хлебом, священников его облеку спасением и воскликнут от радости его святые.
reading.question: What blessings does God promise to Zion?
options: Abundant food for the poor, salvation for priests, and joy for the saints
reading.correct: Abundant food for the poor, salvation for priests, and joy for the saints
reading.explain: God promises 'благословлю его пищей, нищих его насыщу хлебом, священников его облеку спасением' (will bless with food, satisfy the poor with bread, clothe priests with salvation) and the saints will shout for joy.
